comments.author: Rashid
comments.body:
This ship is pretty good for stock (turn speed is good) , but the drawback is
not enough sailor cabin to support the firepower of 3 broadside (16x3=48cannon)
Heavy Frigate in the other hand fair better (But the limit sailor cabin still affect the firepower)
jus asking , is this one good to lvl up to martime lv 52?

comments.author: Maxziro
comments.body: In my opinion,using a TLG with 4 broadside is better than using this :)

comments.author: Realist
comments.body:
Would agree with Maxziro's opinion. Get yourself an iron plated r20 min size TLG, fusion a 5th broadside into it in a G1 fusion and you have a cheap, very decent grinder ship.

The frigate will do for a while to lowlevel grind, but grinding on higher npc you ll be more comfortable with more dura and the additional broadsides.
